mods.name: LinRTX (DLSS 4.5 + DLSS-RR + Frame Gen + RTX HDR)
mods.description: Native Linux OpenGL-to-Vulkan NVIDIA NGX bridge bringing DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution (Transformer Presets J, K, L, M), DLSS Ray Reconstruction (Presets D, E, F) & Vulkan SVGF Denoising, DLSS-G Frame Generation (2x/3x/4x), and RTX HDR / TrueHDR into Minecraft 26.2 with live in-game preset switching and Iris / Sodium / Distant Horizons compatibility.
